name: com.finflashes/finflashes
title: FinFlashes: India Market News, Flows and Macro Data
description: Indian market news summaries by stock and date, FII/FPI and mutual fund flows, ownership, macro data

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the datasets available to you: what each holds and its date coverage. Start here.

tools.name: get_releases
tools.description: Statistics as first published by the source (first prints), as captured by FinFlashes: the scheduled release time, when we recorded the number, and the delay we recorded. Times are UTC; release_at_ist is the release time in India (IST), ready to show. India rows also carry `quote`, the sentence from the official press release that printed the number, when FinFlashes holds it: use it to quote the release word for word. Filter by dataset and series. Each call uses one FinFlashes lookup from a small daily allowance, so ask for the whole date range in one call instead of one call per year.

dataset.description: a releases dataset id from list_datasets; default all

series.description: series key or part of its name, e.g. CPI

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Economic release calendar between two dates (default: the last 7 days to 30 days ahead), with scheduled times and, once out, the actual value. release_at is UTC; release_at_ist is the same time in India (IST), ready to show. Each call uses one FinFlashes lookup from a small daily allowance, so ask for the whole date range in one call instead of one call per year.

dataset.description: a calendar dataset id from list_datasets; default all

tools.name: get_table
tools.description: Rows from a tabular dataset (flows, holdings, money markets, mutual funds, IPOs, index closes, power and more), newest first by the dataset's date column. Filter by date range and exact column values. The reply says how many rows matched, and has_more / next_offset when there are more to page through. list_datasets shows each table's columns. Each call uses one FinFlashes lookup from a small daily allowance, so ask for the whole date range in one call instead of one call per year.

dataset.description: a table dataset id from list_datasets

from.description: earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD (YYYY-MM and YYYY also work); applies to the dataset's date column

to.description: latest date, same formats as from

tools.name: show_india_macro_dashboard
tools.description: Show an interactive dashboard of statistics published by India's government, as first published: CPI inflation, industrial production (IIP) growth and real GDP growth, with their history, the latest US policy rate, inflation and unemployment figures, and the next scheduled releases. Open data only. Hosts that can't show the page get a text summary. Each call uses one FinFlashes lookup from a small daily allowance, so ask for the whole date range in one call instead of one call per year.
